headlines.title: OpenAI Is Buying Google’s AI Chips, a Hit to Nvidia’s Biggest Customer Bond
headlines.summary: OpenAI reportedly buying Google's custom AI chips would quietly shift leverage in one of the most lucrative vendor relationships in tech, and the fallout for NVIDIA's pricing power and Alphabet's chip ambitions is only beginning to take shape.

headlines.title: US Stock Futures Mixed Ahead of Alphabet, Microsoft Earnings and Federal Reserve Rate Decision: Dow Jones, S&P, Nasdaq, Wall Street
headlines.summary: US stock futures traded in mixed territory on Wednesday as investors prepared for quarterly results from major technology companies and the Federal Reserve’s latest interest rate decision. Alphabet and Microsoft are scheduled to report after the market closes, while stronger-than-expected earnings from South Korean semiconductor manufacturer SK Hynix provided further evidence of demand linked to artificial intelligence infrastructure.

headlines.title: YouTube Is Beating Netflix in the Living Room, but Crypto Bettors Doubt a $12 Billion Ad Quarter for the Alphabet Platform
headlines.summary: YouTube has stepped up its push for living-room viewers with exclusive creator shows and a growing subscription business, intensifying competition with Netflix Inc. (NASDAQ:NFLX). Ahead of Alphabet Inc.’s (NASDAQ:GOOG) (NASDAQ:GOOGL) third-quarter earnings report, crypto punters are also wagering on whether YouTube’s advertising revenue will top $12 billion.

headlines.title: 3 Founder Led Stocks With Revenue Growth Up To 12%
headlines.summary: AI related spending is under the microscope as Google, Microsoft, and Amazon face pressure to show how heavy outlays turn into hard cash returns. When capital suddenly has to justify itself, leadership that owns a big chunk of the business can matter more than ever. This article walks through three founder run stocks from our US universe, where the person in charge is heavily tied to the long term outcome.

headlines.title: Cerebras Gains 10% on Oracle Cloud Deal as “AI Inference Demands Choice”
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysCerebras shares jumped 10% and Oracle rose 4% on Tuesday, Oct. 27, after Oracle announced a set of AI deals at its AI World event.

description: Alphabet Inc. offers various products and platforms in the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia-Pacific, Canada, and Latin America. It operates through Google Services, Google Cloud, and Other Bets segments. The Google Services segment provides products and services, including ads, Android, Chrome, devices, Gmail, Google Drive, Google Maps, Google Photos, Google Play, Search, and YouTube. It is also involved in the sale of apps and in-app purchases and digital content in Google Play and YouTube; and devices, as well as the provision of YouTube consumer subscription services, such as YouTube TV, YouTube Music and Premium, NFL Sunday Ticket, and Google One. The Google Cloud segment offers consumption-based fees and subscriptions for AI solutions, including AI infrastructure, Vertex AI platform, and Gemini enterprise. It also provides cybersecurity, and data and analytics services; Google Workspace that include cloud-based communication and collaboration tools for enterprises, such as Calendar, Gmail, Docs, Drive, and Meet; and other enterprise services. The Other Bets segment sells transportation and internet services. Alphabet Inc. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Mountain View, California.
